ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 8, 2023
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Margo Morales, Chair  Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner
Barbara A. Pollack, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  23-25090  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Ethics Commission meetings on
  Wednesday, October 11, 2023 and October 25, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  23-25091  Recommendation to conduct a study session regarding the evaluation and
  discussion of applicants for the Commission’s current vacancy; and, if appropriate,
  identify and approve the list of candidates to interview.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  23-25092  Recommendation to discuss a report on public input received regarding the
  proposed changes to the lobbyist ordinance and provide direction to the Ad Hoc
  Committee for next steps.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  23-25093  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  23-25094  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the Ad Hoc Committees; discuss
  anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate, take
  action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.
